newsitem.title: USA: Global One chairman, 3 directors resign.
newsitem.headline: Global One chairman, 3 directors resign.

text.p: Global One Distribution said Joseph Angard resigned as chairman and chief executive officer and will act as a consultant for three years.
Angard also agreed to sell 2,000,000 shares of stock and surrender another 920,000 shares thereby relinquishing his position as the principal stockholder of the company.

George Vrabeck will resign as president and chief operating officer to succeed Angard as chairman and chief executive officer. Three other directors, Edward Sacks, Stephen Horowitz and Mark Hauser have also resigned. The Company will seek to fill these vacancies.

The shares Angard surrendered will be restricted for one year from date of purchase. The 2,000,000 shares will be purchased at $0.50 a share. Angard will receive $100,000 in cash and advance the remaining $900,000 to the company or its subsidiary, OSP Publishing.
The company said its financial position has been enhanced as a result of Angard's loan of $900,000 and the company continues to negotiate a new line of credit.

For the most recent quarter, Global reported a net loss of $1.9 million. On July 25, it announced its lender Foothill Financial had ceased advancing funds because it had not been in compliance with lending formulas under the credit line.
